title: Help for Firms to Boost Productivity with Progressive Wage Model's Approach to Wage Increases
what_it_is: Help for Firms to Boost Productivity with Progressive Wage Model's Approach to Wage Increases

sections.label: Industry Transformation Maps and NTUC support
sections.summary: ITMs map growth plans for 23 sectors, with Government schemes and NTUC CTC grants supporting business transformation and job redesign.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Our Progressive Wage moves are complemented by the Industry Transformation Maps, or ITMs, which map out growth and transformation plans for 23 sectors across the economy.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Businesses can find support for their transformation journeys through various Government schemes, such as the Productivity Solutions Grant.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: They can also consider working with the National Trades Union Congress (NTUC) to set up Company Training Committees, or CTCs, and tap on the NTUC CTC grant, launched in 2022, to transform business processes, redesign jobs and improve work prospects for the workers.

sections.label: PWCS and WSS Scheme support
sections.summary: PWCS co-funds lower-wage worker wage increases from 2022 to 2026, enhanced to 75% for 2023, while WSS provides 95% absentee payroll for training.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The Progressive Wage Credit Scheme (PWCS) co-funds the wage increases employers give to their lower-wage workers from 2022 to 2026.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: And as announced in Budget 2023, the co-funding support for PWCS will be enhanced up to 75% for the qualifying year 2023.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Meanwhile, the WSS Scheme provides employers with an absentee payroll of 95% of basic wages when their workers are sent for training.

sections.label: Security and retail PWM progress
sections.summary: Security has seen good progress, and for newer PWMs like retail, a Jobs-Skills Integrator is being trialled by MTI.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: We have seen that in security, for example, which have seen very good progress.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: And with the newer industries or newer PWMs, like retail, for example, we are looking at areas such as putting in the Jobs-Skills Integrator, which I think the Ministry for Trade and Industry (MTI) is trialling.

sections.label: Varying outcomes and service buyer role
sections.summary: Outcomes vary by company and sector, and service buyers and consumers have a role in procuring services based on outcomes rather than head counts.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: The outcomes vary, depending on how different companies progress and how different sectors progress.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: I also want to add on that service buyers and consumers also have a role to play, because I think we have also moved into procuring services based on outcomes, rather than just head counts.
